source: Tan, Tamisha & Kühlert (2020), in the Proceedings of the Workshop on Turkic and Languages in Contact with Turkic 5. 140–154.
chapter: The Double Duty of the Sakha “Passive”
topic: The Double Duty of the Sakha “Passive”
notes: Recent work by Legate & Akkuş (2017) and Legate et al. (2020) argues that this doubling involves two functionally distinct but homophonous morphemes which head distinct projections stacked atop each other: namely, ImpersP and VoiceP. In the related Northern Siberian language Sakha, the default passive marker has the form -IlIn-.
